## What `crimes context src/Card.tsx` adds over the scan Three things the scan JSON didn't tell me: - **No tests, no importers.** No test file matches `Card` by any convention, and 0 direct importers. `test_gap: 1.0` on all three findings is real, not a proxy artifact. Blast radius 0 means I can change the component's prop signature freely — nothing downstream breaks. - **Churn is cold** — 2 commits/90d, last touched 3 months ago, 1 author. This isn't a file being actively fought over; a single consolidated refactor won't collide with anyone. - **No keyed agent guidance and no neighbourhood signal.** There's no sibling component to copy conventions from, which is exactly why the raw values in here are dangerous: an agent extending this file has nothing else to imitate, so it will copy `#ff00aa` forward. One thing neither the scan nor context caught, which I found reading the file: **the fixed widths already overflow at desktop.** `src/Card.tsx:24` is 720px and `:27` is 240px inside an 800px box with 24px padding — 960px of content in 752px of space. The responsive finding understates this; the layout is broken at *every* viewport, not just small ones. I have **not** edited the fixture — `evals/fixtures/` is scanner input, so changing it would move the eval baseline. And the sidebar became a prop because the hardcoded `"sidebar"` string at `:28` was placeholder text; if it's meant to be fixed content, inline it and drop the prop. ## Order of operations Test gap is 1.0 and there is no test file, so nothing will catch a regression here. 1. **Write the test first** — RTL: `getByRole("button", { name: "Open card" })` reachable via keyboard, fires on Enter and Space. That single test locks in crime_00001 and fails loudly if someone reverts to a `div`. 2. **Tokens before component.** Land `tailwind.config.ts` with design sign-off on the color mapping; the component change is mechanical once the tokens exist. 3. **Component**, then re-run `crimes scan`. All three fingerprints (`accessible_interaction_risk::src/Card.tsx::`, `design_token_escape::src/Card.tsx::`, `responsive_fragility::src/Card.tsx::`) should disappear — if `design_token_escape` survives, a raw value got missed, since the detector counts literals rather than judging them. Blast radius 0 makes the prop-signature change (`onActivate`, `sidebar`) free right now. That's a property of the file being unused, and it expires the moment someone imports it — which is the argument for doing this before the component spreads, not after.
